scripts.dev: npm run build -w @incidentbrief/contracts && concurrently -k 'npm run dev -w @incidentbrief/api' 'npm run dev -w @incidentbrief/web'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @incidentbrief/contracts && npm run build -w @incidentbrief/web && npm run build -w @incidentbrief/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @incidentbrief/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.db:profile: npm run build -w @incidentbrief/contracts && npm run db:profile -w @incidentbrief/api --
